system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global geomorphometric vector ruggedness measure coverage
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m vector ruggedness measure dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric vector ruggedness measure tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only
data_description.records: 1148 spatial vector ruggedness measure tiles in collection

band_semantics.b1: Vector Ruggedness Measure (VRM) raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`. Measures terrain ruggedness by quantifying variation in three-dimensional orientation of grid cells; values range from 0 (flat) to 1 (most rugged).

data_description.important_note: Description fields below were populated from an actual Earth Engine ImageCollection probe. The collection is organized as spatial vector ruggedness measure tiles, not as a dated time series.
analytical_capabilities: Marine and terrestrial habitat heterogeneity assessment

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Vector Ruggedness Measure values ranging from 0 to 1, calculated from dispersion of unit vectors orthogonal to terrain surface; higher values indicate more rugged, heterogeneous terrain.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
